Money — Quick Reference

Key Formulas / Values

1 Rupee = 100 Paise, 1 Rupee = Rs. 1, To find the total cost of items: Total Cost = Number of Items * Price per Item

Mnemonics

Remember that 100 paise makes 1 rupee, always keep the conversion handy to solve problems easily

Key Points

  • Know the denominations of currency and coins
  • Understand the concept of making the smallest amount using the largest denomination
  • Practice converting rupees to paise and vice versa
  • Learn to calculate the total cost of items by multiplying the number of items by the price per item
